summary: Anthropic launched Claude for Teachers, a free product for verified US K-12 educators that connects Claude to state academic standards, curricular resources, and a set of education-tool connectors, and includes Claude Code/Cowork agentic features for lesson planning and scheduled recurring tasks.

practices.reason: The product describes a concrete pattern of handing off a recurring task to an agent that runs unattended on a schedule, which is a reusable orchestration pattern though demonstrated only in this product context.
practices.quote: Hand off a task once—like reviewing each day's de-identified exit tickets to see what students mastered and adapting tomorrow's plan to match—and it runs every school day at 4pm. Claude works while you drive home.

practices.reason: Anthropic states it is publishing a technical write-up of how it evaluated the teaching skills for rigor and usability, which other builders could reuse as a measurement method, though the method itself is not detailed in this document.
practices.quote: an open-source repository of the teaching skills, and a technical write-up of how we evaluated these skills and how other builders in education can use them.

practices.reason: New connectors are being added to Anthropic's public connector directory, which is a new integration surface for developers building education tools, though no API or breaking changes are described.
practices.quote: This includes the launch of new connectors in Anthropic’s directory, an open-source repository of the teaching skills, and a technical write-up of how we evaluated these skills and how other builders in education can use them.
